title: Reciprocity Separates Gradient Flow from Rotation in Conservative Physical Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physical learning lets a trainable material or network use its own physical response to carry error signals, reducing the need for a separately programmed backward computation. We ask what determines whether such a system follows conventional gradient descent or evolves along a genuinely different learning trajectory. Our canonical model is a directed layered transport network in which every node redistributes a fixed amount of flow, so learning preserves positivity and total mass. In this model, conservation constrains only the allowable learning directions. Within the matched response class studied here, adjoint matching gives the physical output response a symmetric form. Non-negative mode-wise feedback then produces a reciprocal closed-loop response and a reweighted gradient flow. translated_title: 互易性在保守物理学习中区分梯度流与旋转
translated_abstract: 物理学习让可训练的材料或网络利用其自身的物理响应来携带误差信号，从而减少对单独编程的反向计算的需求。我们探究是什么决定了这样的系统是遵循传统的梯度下降，还是沿着一条真正不同的学习轨迹演化。我们的典范模型是一个有向分层传输网络，其中每个节点重新分配固定量的流量，因此学习过程保持正性与总质量守恒。在该模型中，守恒律仅约束允许的学习方向。在本文所研究的匹配响应类中，伴随匹配赋予物理输出响应对称的形式。非负的逐模式反馈进而产生互易的闭环响应与重新加权的梯度流。加入反对称的边界分量则使闭环响应具有旋转性：学习路径可以发生转向，而驱动该更新的误差仍然……
tldr: 该研究在有向分层传输网络模型中证明，闭环响应的互易对称性使守恒物理学习系统执行重新加权的梯度流，而反对称边界分量则引入旋转动力学，从而揭示了物理学习何时偏离标准梯度下降的机制。
en_tdlr: In conservative physical learning, reciprocal closed-loop responses yield reweighted gradient flow, while antisymmetric boundary components introduce rotation, explaining when physical systems deviate from standard gradient descent.
